name: claujev-mod
description: Applies Jev's effort suggestion per request, shows Jev's activity in the status line and toasts when Jev acts. Needs the claujev plugin.

effort.title: Automatic effort
effort.description: observe shows Jev's suggested effort in the status line; on applies it to each request (within the limits below); off does nothing.

min_effort.title: Lowest effort
min_effort.description: Jev never sets the effort below this.

max_effort.title: Highest effort
max_effort.description: Jev never sets the effort above this.

status.title: Status line
status.description: Show Jev's activity of the day in the status line.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of the status line, toasts and the /claujev command.
